summary: Iteration 2 — focused regression on OKX friendly errors + new real-wallet/exchange capability endpoints + web3 self-custody balances. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_new_endpoints.py (16 tests, 16/16 pass) and re-ran /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (31/31 pass). Total 47/47 backend tests pass. Frontend: admin login, Settings → Wallet tab shows REAL WALLET section with 'Connect an exchange wallet below…' hint while disconnected; EXCHANGE_WALLETS buttons jump to the Exchange tab (verified okx → settings-tab-select == 'exchange'); OKX help text mentions Read+Trade and region/auto detection; manual paste+LINK of bc1qxy2kgdygjrsqtzq2n0yrf2493p83kkfjhx0wlh produces a linked row with real BTC balance 3.92652888 BTC · $316,051.81 served from mempool.space via /api/wallet/web3; sync balances link works; payment app click shows numbered steps; unlink works; config/guardrails/brokers/alerts tabs still render. OKX friendly-error toast flow was not exercised through the UI (exchange form requires exchange selection first and only 2 inputs were visible in the time-boxed sweep), but the backend behaviour is proven: real user key id f6f0e985-… + bogus secret/passphrase surfaces OKX 50105/50113 (host rotation reached us.okx.com, past 50119) and a random fake key surfaces 50119 with the friendly 'global/US/EEA' message; no exchange_credentials row is persisted and bot.exchange_connected stays false. All nine new live-only endpoints (/api/exchange/capabilities, /api/exchange/sync, /api/exchange/order BUY+SELL, /api/wallet/real/networks, /api/wallet/real/deposit-address, /api/wallet/real/withdraw, /api/wallet/real/transfer, /api/wallet/real/history) correctly return 400 'No exchange connected' — never 500 — when no credentials exist.
critical_code_review_comments: exchange_service.verify() iterates OKX_HOSTS and only continues on 50119/50111; good — stops early on 50105/50113 so we don't hammer other regions with a wrong passphrase/secret.
exchange_service.friendly() strips whitespace from the error string before matching code — robust against ccxt's variable formatting.
engine.with_exchange wraps all ccxt exceptions in HTTPException(400, friendly(e)); endpoints never leak 500 — confirmed by parametrised test.
web3bal.balance swallows network errors to return None; combined with /api/wallet/web3 that means a dead mempool.space returns balance=null (not an error). Acceptable UX; the row renders '—'.
server.py is 725 lines — slightly over the 700-line soft limit. Consider splitting the exchange/wallet routers into exchange_router.py and wallet_router.py.
wallet_transfer uses `acc[::-1]` to reverse account tuple — tidy, but a comment would help future readers.
Order endpoint price fallback (body.usd / price) uses the current `price` from fetch_ticker — safe for live BUY sizing, matches market_order internals.

rca of the issue: User reported OKX 50119 'API key doesn't exist' because they were using an OKX US key against the global www.okx.com endpoint. Fix in exchange_service.verify() iterates OKX_HOSTS = [www, us, eea, my, app] and only continues host rotation while the error is 50119/50111; this exposes the real underlying error (50105/50113) once a region recognises the key. Confirmed: with the user's real key id and a wrong passphrase we now receive 50105 'OKX passphrase is wrong' instead of 50119 — proving us.okx.com was contacted. The friendly() mapping surfaces user-readable text with the OKX error code appended for support. Self-custody 'Not Found' toast is resolved by the new POST /api/wallet/web3/link endpoint that persists the manual address and GET /api/wallet/web3 that returns real BTC/ETH balances from mempool.space and ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com (verified: 3.92652888 BTC · $316,051.81 for the test genesis address).
